title: 분식집에서 포장 주문하기: 포장해 주세요
objective: You can order food to go, ask how long it takes, and use polite -겠- sentences such as 주문하시겠어요? and 기다리겠습니다.
summary: A customer orders food to go at a Korean snack shop counter.
setting: A small Korean snack shop (분식집) at lunchtime. A customer orders at the counter and takes the food home.

task.title: Order food to go
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to choose, fill in, or put the words in order.

words.meaning: takeout, to go (food packed to take away)
words.exampleMeaning: Please pack the leftover pizza to go.
Can I get two servings of dakgalbi to go?
You don't need to give me chopsticks.
Please wait outside for a moment.

dialogue.meaning: Welcome. Would you like to order?
Two rolls of gimbap and one serving of tteokbokki, please.
Is that for here or to go?
To go, please. How long will it take?
About 10 minutes. Do you need chopsticks?
Yes, please. I'll wait over there.
Okay, I'll call you when it's ready.

exercises: Choose the right counter: ① 김밥 세 (줄 / 인분) 포장해 주세요. ② 떡볶이 2 (줄 / 인분) 주세요.
Fill in the blank with the polite -겠- form of 하다. The clerk asks you: 주스는 뭐로 ____?
Fill in the blank with -겠-. Your food is not ready, so you tell the clerk you will come back in 20 minutes: 20분 후에 다시 ____. (오다)
Put the words in order to make one sentence: 주세요 / 만두 / 포장해 / 1인분
Answer in Korean. The clerk asks: 젓가락 필요하세요? You need two pairs. Use 개.
answers: 네, 두 개 주세요. (네, 두 개 필요해요.)
